"""Deferred-cycle member ``e``: closes the lap only inside a function.

The import-time subgraph over ``{d, e}`` does not cycle, so the one cycle
owner classifies the component ``deferred_cycle`` — the verdict opposite to
``{f, g}`` below, on the same family.
"""

E_TAG = "e"


def e_probe(value: int) -> int:
    return value * 2


def e_step(value: int) -> int:
    from d import D_TAG

    return value + len(D_TAG)
